FN-SLIMX85-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/03/2026
House Bill 353 as introduced could increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
local boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to provide the
level of additional instructional support for Advanced Math Pathways pursuant to the provisions
of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department
of Education to provide an annual report to the Legislature concerning advanced math pathways.
